technical.summary: ROK shows bullish structure with price above all key moving averages and positive ichimoku signals, but overbought RSI conditions and weak ADX trend strength limit swing entry probability despite neutral sector backdrop.

fundamental.summary: ROK shows minimal fundamental support with no insider/institutional activity, zero government contracts, low lobbying engagement, and earnings in 17 days creating near-term event risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for ROK; congressional activity is mixed and dated (119+ days old), market fear/greed is neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (215.5) indicates extreme market stress, earnings event in 17 days adds binary risk to industrials sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with ichimoku bullish cross and RSI 9 rising trend provides technical structure for swing entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels), high earnings risk in 17 days, weak ADX trend strength, overbought RSI exhaustion, and zero fundamental/smart money support create unacceptable risk/reward for swing trade.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is constructive with price above all major moving averages and ichimoku bullish cross, but macro environment and earnings proximity create unacceptable risk/reward asymmetry for swing trade execution.

decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
